title: Report a problem
privacy: The screenshot may show names, addresses or secrets. Check it before sending, or turn the attachment off.
noScreenshot: The report will be sent without a screenshot.
captureFailed: The screenshot could not be taken. The report can be sent without it.
descriptionPlaceholder: What you did, what you expected and what you saw instead
notConfigured: The mail server is not set up yet. Fill in the settings below to send reports.
notConfiguredAdmin: The mail server for reports is not set up. Ask the administrator to set KUBRON_BUGREPORT_SMTP_*.
sent: The report was sent. Thank you!

mail.cannotSave: The settings cannot be saved here: the master key is not available. Set them with the KUBRON_BUGREPORT_SMTP_* variables.
mail.fromEnvironment: The settings come from the KUBRON_BUGREPORT_SMTP_* variables. Saved settings take priority over them.

hintMail: The report is sent by e-mail to {recipient}. Describe what went wrong; a screenshot of the window helps.
hintRelay: Describe what went wrong and press Send. The screenshot and basic facts are added automatically; no account is needed.
hintQueue: Describe what went wrong and press Send. If there is no connection, the report is saved here and sent later.
pending: {n} report(s) are waiting to be sent.
queued: No connection: the report is saved on this computer and will be sent automatically.
